entries.originalEnglish: We need the exact offense and disposition from the court record. Delaware's mandatory, discretionary, pardon and juvenile procedures have different exclusions; this category alone does not establish ineligibility.
entries.en: We need the exact offense and disposition from the court record. Delaware's mandatory, discretionary, pardon and juvenile procedures have different exclusions; this category alone does not establish ineligibility.
entries.es: Necesitamos el delito exacto y el resultado que constan en el expediente judicial. Los procedimientos de Delaware de eliminación obligatoria, discrecional, después de un indulto y de antecedentes juveniles tienen exclusiones diferentes; esta categoría por sí sola no demuestra que no pueda obtener alivio.

entries.originalEnglish: We need the exact offense and disposition to check Delaware §§ 4372(f) and 4374(b). A misdemeanor listed in § 4373(b) may instead be considered under § 4374(a)(2), subject to its seven-year waiting period and other conditions.
entries.en: We need the exact offense and disposition to check Delaware §§ 4372(f) and 4374(b). A misdemeanor listed in § 4373(b) may instead be considered under § 4374(a)(2), subject to its seven-year waiting period and other conditions.
entries.es: Necesitamos el delito exacto y el resultado del caso para aplicar las secciones 4372(f) y 4374(b) de Delaware. Un delito menor incluido en la sección 4373(b) puede ser considerado conforme a la sección 4374(a)(2), sujeto a su plazo de espera de siete años y a las demás condiciones.

entries.originalEnglish: This category alone does not establish a Delaware discretionary exclusion. Check the exact conviction against §§ 4372(f) and 4374(b), and the separate eligibility conditions in § 4374(a), before preparing a packet.
entries.en: This category alone does not establish a Delaware discretionary exclusion. Check the exact conviction against §§ 4372(f) and 4374(b), and the separate eligibility conditions in § 4374(a), before preparing a packet.
entries.es: Esta categoría por sí sola no demuestra que exista una exclusión del procedimiento discrecional de Delaware. Antes de preparar los documentos, se debe comprobar la condena exacta conforme a las secciones 4372(f) y 4374(b), y las condiciones de elegibilidad de la sección 4374(a).

entries.originalEnglish: We need the program named in the court order and whether the court has entered the required dismissal or closure. Completing program tasks alone does not establish that the case was closed.
entries.en: We need the program named in the court order and whether the court has entered the required dismissal or closure. Completing program tasks alone does not establish that the case was closed.
entries.es: Necesitamos saber qué programa se indica en la orden judicial y si el tribunal ha dictado la desestimación o el cierre requerido. Cumplir las tareas del programa por sí solo no demuestra que el caso se haya cerrado.

entries.originalEnglish: The felony count exceeds the total conviction count. Check the case records before continuing.
entries.en: The felony count exceeds the total conviction count. Check the case records before continuing.
entries.es: El número de condenas por delitos graves supera el número total de condenas. Revise los expedientes antes de continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: The earlier answer does not establish whether there was a later conviction. Check the disposition and date of the later case before deciding this sealing request.
entries.en: The earlier answer does not establish whether there was a later conviction. Check the disposition and date of the later case before deciding this sealing request.
entries.es: La respuesta anterior no establece si hubo una condena posterior. Revise la resolución y la fecha del caso posterior antes de decidir sobre esta solicitud de sellado.

entries.originalEnglish: A prior sealing order alone does not establish the statutory limit. Check which sealing law the order uses and which convictions it sealed before deciding this request.
entries.en: A prior sealing order alone does not establish the statutory limit. Check which sealing law the order uses and which convictions it sealed before deciding this request.
entries.es: Una orden de sellado anterior por sí sola no establece el límite legal. Revise qué ley de sellado utiliza la orden y qué condenas selló antes de decidir sobre esta solicitud.

entries.originalEnglish: NY CPL 160.59 bars a later criminal conviction after the last conviction for which sealing is requested.
entries.en: NY CPL 160.59 bars a later criminal conviction after the last conviction for which sealing is requested.
entries.es: CPL 160.59 de Nueva York impide el sellado si existe una condena penal posterior a la última condena cuyo sellado se solicita.

entries.originalEnglish: This case is still in the program or admission stage. Discuss the active case with your lawyer or the program office. Admission is discretionary; this result does not establish admission eligibility, successful completion, dismissal, or expungement. No expungement packet opens at this stage.
entries.en: This case is still in the program or admission stage. Discuss the active case with your lawyer or the program office. Admission is discretionary; this result does not establish admission eligibility, successful completion, dismissal, or expungement. No expungement packet opens at this stage.
entries.es: Este caso sigue en la etapa del programa o de admisión. Consulte sobre el caso activo con su abogado o con la oficina del programa. La admisión es discrecional; este resultado no establece que reúna los requisitos de admisión, que haya completado el programa satisfactoriamente, que el caso se haya desestimado ni que sus antecedentes se hayan eliminado. En esta etapa no se ofrece un paquete de eliminación de antecedentes.

entries.originalEnglish: This option requires a final felony conviction in this case. The outcome entered does not confirm that fact. Check the final court record or get help identifying the disposition; the original charge level does not establish a conviction.
entries.en: This option requires a final felony conviction in this case. The outcome entered does not confirm that fact. Check the final court record or get help identifying the disposition; the original charge level does not establish a conviction.
entries.es: Esta opción requiere una condena final por un delito grave en este caso. El resultado que indicó no confirma ese hecho. Revise el registro final del tribunal o busque ayuda para identificar el resultado; el nivel del cargo original no establece que hubo una condena.

entries.originalEnglish: Check whether the original sentence imposed First Offender treatment, its current status, and the sentencing or discharge date requested. Completing a program or requesting retroactive treatment does not establish those facts.
entries.en: Check whether the original sentence imposed First Offender treatment, its current status, and the sentencing or discharge date requested. Completing a program or requesting retroactive treatment does not establish those facts.
entries.es: Confirme si la sentencia original dispuso el tratamiento de First Offender, su estado actual y la fecha solicitada de sentencia o descargo. Completar un programa o solicitar tratamiento retroactivo no establece esos hechos.

entries.originalEnglish: The record says the First Offender sentence was revoked and guilt was adjudicated. The original First Offender restriction and sealing procedure cannot be treated as a successful discharge. Get help reviewing the final order and any other available procedure.
entries.en: The record says the First Offender sentence was revoked and guilt was adjudicated. The original First Offender restriction and sealing procedure cannot be treated as a successful discharge. Get help reviewing the final order and any other available procedure.
entries.es: El expediente indica que se revocó la sentencia de First Offender y se adjudicó la culpabilidad. El procedimiento de restricción y sellado de la sentencia original de First Offender no puede tratarse como un descargo satisfactorio. Busque ayuda para revisar la orden final y cualquier otro procedimiento disponible.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the cannabis statute, final case outcome and requested next step. A charge level or completed program alone does not establish a qualifying conviction; nonfinancial completion is separate from money paid.
entries.en: Check the cannabis statute, final case outcome and requested next step. A charge level or completed program alone does not establish a qualifying conviction; nonfinancial completion is separate from money paid.
entries.es: Revise la ley sobre cannabis, el resultado final del caso y el siguiente paso solicitado. El nivel de un cargo o haber completado un programa no establece por sí solo una condena que reúna los requisitos; cumplir las condiciones no económicas es diferente de pagar dinero.

entries.originalEnglish: The cannabis motion covers misdemeanor and Class 4 felony convictions. The class entered is outside that motion's scope. Review the final record and other available remedies; this is not a denial of every record-clearing option.
entries.en: The cannabis motion covers misdemeanor and Class 4 felony convictions. The class entered is outside that motion's scope. Review the final record and other available remedies; this is not a denial of every record-clearing option.
entries.es: La moción por cannabis cubre condenas por delitos menores y delitos graves de clase 4. La clase indicada queda fuera del alcance de esa moción. Revise el registro final y otros remedios disponibles; esto no es una denegación de todas las opciones para limpiar los antecedentes.

entries.originalEnglish: Checking whether this cannabis record was already cleared does not request a motion to set aside a conviction. Review the current criminal-history record and the applicable automatic or pardon process. This result does not confirm that expungement occurred or open a filing packet.
entries.en: Checking whether this cannabis record was already cleared does not request a motion to set aside a conviction. Review the current criminal-history record and the applicable automatic or pardon process. This result does not confirm that expungement occurred or open a filing packet.
entries.es: Verificar si este registro por cannabis ya fue eliminado no solicita una moción para dejar sin efecto una condena. Revise el registro actual de antecedentes y el proceso automático o de indulto aplicable. Este resultado no confirma que se hayan eliminado los antecedentes ni habilita un paquete para presentar al tribunal.

entries.originalEnglish: The cannabis motion requires completion of the nonfinancial sentence and conditions. The answer says a nonfinancial requirement remains; paying a balance alone does not complete it.
entries.en: The cannabis motion requires completion of the nonfinancial sentence and conditions. The answer says a nonfinancial requirement remains; paying a balance alone does not complete it.
entries.es: La moción por cannabis requiere cumplir la sentencia y las condiciones no económicas. La respuesta indica que queda un requisito no económico pendiente; pagar un saldo por sí solo no lo cumple.

entries.originalEnglish: The record may fit the separate cannabis-conviction motion. Unpaid financial obligations alone do not establish that its nonfinancial completion requirement is unmet. The applicable form and route still require review before a packet can be prepared.
entries.en: The record may fit the separate cannabis-conviction motion. Unpaid financial obligations alone do not establish that its nonfinancial completion requirement is unmet. The applicable form and route still require review before a packet can be prepared.
entries.es: El registro podría corresponder a la moción separada por condena de cannabis. Las obligaciones económicas pendientes, por sí solas, no establecen que falte cumplir las condiciones no económicas. El formulario y el procedimiento aplicables aún requieren revisión antes de preparar un paquete.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the law, court, final case outcome and any diversion agreement. A city police arrest, charge level or program admission alone does not establish a municipal conviction or fulfilled diversion.
entries.en: Check the law, court, final case outcome and any diversion agreement. A city police arrest, charge level or program admission alone does not establish a municipal conviction or fulfilled diversion.
entries.es: Revise la ley, el tribunal, el resultado final del caso y cualquier acuerdo de desvío. Un arresto por la policía municipal, el nivel del cargo o la admisión a un programa no establece por sí solo una condena municipal ni un acuerdo de desvío cumplido.

entries.originalEnglish: This district-court arrest record needs review under the applicable arrest-record procedure. It cannot be substituted into a municipal ordinance packet or a conviction-and-diversion packet.
entries.en: This district-court arrest record needs review under the applicable arrest-record procedure. It cannot be substituted into a municipal ordinance packet or a conviction-and-diversion packet.
entries.es: Este registro de arresto de un caso del tribunal de distrito necesita revisión conforme al procedimiento aplicable a los registros de arresto. No puede tramitarse con un paquete de ordenanza municipal ni con un paquete de condena y desvío.

entries.originalEnglish: The answer says the diversion agreement remains unfulfilled. Do not start a completed-diversion waiting period from admission or arrest. Review the agreement and any specific statutory exception before choosing a filing procedure.
entries.en: The answer says the diversion agreement remains unfulfilled. Do not start a completed-diversion waiting period from admission or arrest. Review the agreement and any specific statutory exception before choosing a filing procedure.
entries.es: La respuesta indica que el acuerdo de desvío aún no se ha cumplido. No calcule el período de espera por desvío cumplido desde la admisión o el arresto. Revise el acuerdo y cualquier excepción legal específica antes de elegir un procedimiento de presentación.

entries.originalEnglish: This answer does not establish the conviction records required for a discretionary request. Review the final outcomes for every case requested, including any conviction supporting a combined petition. A dismissal or program answer alone cannot open this conviction packet; mandatory, pardon and prosecutor-initiated procedures have separate requirements.
entries.en: This answer does not establish the conviction records required for a discretionary request. Review the final outcomes for every case requested, including any conviction supporting a combined petition. A dismissal or program answer alone cannot open this conviction packet; mandatory, pardon and prosecutor-initiated procedures have separate requirements.
entries.es: Esta respuesta no establece los registros de condena necesarios para una solicitud discrecional. Revise los resultados finales de cada caso solicitado, incluida cualquier condena que sustente una petición conjunta. Una respuesta de desestimación o de programa por sí sola no permite abrir este paquete de condena; los procedimientos obligatorios, de indulto e iniciados por el fiscal tienen requisitos distintos.

entries.originalEnglish: You reported that court requirements are complete but that not all amounts were paid. Check whether any amount was waived, changed, converted to a civil judgment, or remains unpaid, including restitution. Keep the payment answer as recorded; completing requirements does not by itself prove payment or a legal exception.
entries.en: You reported that court requirements are complete but that not all amounts were paid. Check whether any amount was waived, changed, converted to a civil judgment, or remains unpaid, including restitution. Keep the payment answer as recorded; completing requirements does not by itself prove payment or a legal exception.
entries.es: Usted indicó que cumplió los requisitos del tribunal, pero que no se pagaron todos los montos. Revise si algún monto fue eximido, modificado, convertido en una sentencia civil o sigue sin pagarse, incluida la restitución. Conserve la respuesta de pago tal como se registró; cumplir los requisitos no demuestra por sí solo el pago ni una excepción legal.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the conditional-discharge order, completion and final dismissal. A drug charge or finished probation alone does not establish this procedure.
entries.en: Check the conditional-discharge order, completion and final dismissal. A drug charge or finished probation alone does not establish this procedure.
entries.es: Revise la orden de descargo condicional, el cumplimiento y la desestimación final. Un cargo por drogas o haber terminado la libertad condicional no establece por sí solo este procedimiento.

entries.originalEnglish: The recorded subsection, earlier controlled-substance conviction, earlier conditional discharge, or judgment of guilt needs review under this specific procedure. This does not decide whether a different remedy is available.
entries.en: The recorded subsection, earlier controlled-substance conviction, earlier conditional discharge, or judgment of guilt needs review under this specific procedure. This does not decide whether a different remedy is available.
entries.es: El inciso registrado, una condena anterior por sustancias controladas, un descargo condicional anterior o una sentencia de culpabilidad requiere revisión conforme a este procedimiento específico. Esto no decide si hay otro remedio disponible.

entries.originalEnglish: The discharge or dismissal date must describe an event that has already occurred. Check the court record before continuing.
entries.en: The discharge or dismissal date must describe an event that has already occurred. Check the court record before continuing.
entries.es: La fecha del descargo o de la desestimación debe corresponder a un acto que ya ocurrió. Consulte el expediente judicial antes de continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: This sealing application cannot proceed while an arrest remains unresolved, even if no charge has been filed. Confirm its disposition before continuing.
entries.en: This sealing application cannot proceed while an arrest remains unresolved, even if no charge has been filed. Confirm its disposition before continuing.
entries.es: Esta solicitud de sellado no puede continuar mientras un arresto siga sin resolverse, aunque no se haya presentado un cargo. Confirme su resolución antes de continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: Check whether any arrest is still unresolved. An answer about pending charges or supervision does not establish the status of an arrest with no charge filed.
entries.en: Check whether any arrest is still unresolved. An answer about pending charges or supervision does not establish the status of an arrest with no charge filed.
entries.es: Compruebe si algún arresto sigue sin resolverse. Una respuesta sobre cargos pendientes o supervisión no establece el estado de un arresto sin cargos presentados.

entries.originalEnglish: Nevada uses record sealing, not expungement.
entries.en: Nevada uses record sealing, not expungement.
entries.es: Nevada utiliza el sellado de antecedentes, no la eliminación de antecedentes.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the sentencing and release dates. Each supplied date must be a real calendar date for an event that has already occurred.
entries.en: Check the sentencing and release dates. Each supplied date must be a real calendar date for an event that has already occurred.
entries.es: Revise las fechas de la sentencia y de la puesta en libertad. Cada fecha indicada debe ser una fecha válida del calendario y corresponder a un hecho que ya ocurrió.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the program order, successful completion, final case disposition, and arrest and release record. A program name or elapsed time alone does not establish the completed event.
entries.en: Check the program order, successful completion, final case disposition, and arrest and release record. A program name or elapsed time alone does not establish the completed event.
entries.es: Revise la orden del programa, el cumplimiento satisfactorio, la resolución final del caso y el registro de arresto y puesta en libertad. El nombre de un programa o el tiempo transcurrido no establece por sí solo que se hayan cumplido estos requisitos.

entries.originalEnglish: This procedure requires an arrest and release in the case. Check the recorded answer before continuing; this does not decide whether another remedy is available.
entries.en: This procedure requires an arrest and release in the case. Check the recorded answer before continuing; this does not decide whether another remedy is available.
entries.es: Este procedimiento requiere un arresto y una puesta en libertad en el caso. Revise la respuesta registrada antes de continuar; esto no decide si hay otro remedio disponible.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the supplied program completion or disposition date. It must be a real calendar date for an event that has already occurred.
entries.en: Check the supplied program completion or disposition date. It must be a real calendar date for an event that has already occurred.
entries.es: Revise la fecha indicada de cumplimiento del programa o de la resolución. Debe ser una fecha válida del calendario y corresponder a un hecho que ya ocurrió.

entries.originalEnglish: The recorded dates or disposition conflict. Check the completion and case records; do not substitute a date for a disposition that was never entered.
entries.en: The recorded dates or disposition conflict. Check the completion and case records; do not substitute a date for a disposition that was never entered.
entries.es: Las fechas o la resolución registradas son contradictorias. Revise los documentos de cumplimiento y del caso; no sustituya con una fecha una resolución que nunca se dictó.

entries.originalEnglish: Were you arrested in this case and then released?
entries.en: Were you arrested in this case and then released?
entries.es: ¿Fue arrestado en este caso y después puesto en libertad?

entries.originalEnglish: If you have it, what date does the record give for successful completion of this program?
entries.en: If you have it, what date does the record give for successful completion of this program?
entries.es: Si la tiene, ¿qué fecha indica el expediente para el cumplimiento satisfactorio de este programa?

entries.originalEnglish: If a dismissal or dropped-charge disposition was entered, what date does that record show?
entries.en: If a dismissal or dropped-charge disposition was entered, what date does that record show?
entries.es: Si se registró una desestimación o el retiro de los cargos, ¿qué fecha indica ese registro?

entries.originalEnglish: Check the exact Delaware conviction, case scope, criminal history and requested procedure. A route label or broad category does not establish these facts.
entries.en: Check the exact Delaware conviction, case scope, criminal history and requested procedure. A route label or broad category does not establish these facts.
entries.es: Revise la condena exacta de Delaware, los casos incluidos, los antecedentes penales y el procedimiento solicitado. Una etiqueta de vía o categoría general no establece estos hechos.

entries.originalEnglish: The Delaware record answers conflict. Confirm the conviction class, sentence, dates and case history before continuing.
entries.en: The Delaware record answers conflict. Confirm the conviction class, sentence, dates and case history before continuing.
entries.es: Las respuestas sobre el registro de Delaware son contradictorias. Confirme la clase de condena, la sentencia, las fechas y los antecedentes del caso antes de continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: A conviction identified here is excluded by §4372(f)(3). This does not decide eligibility under a separate pardon procedure.
entries.en: A conviction identified here is excluded by §4372(f)(3). This does not decide eligibility under a separate pardon procedure.
entries.es: Una condena identificada está excluida por §4372(f)(3). Esto no decide si se reúnen los requisitos de un procedimiento separado de indulto.

entries.originalEnglish: This motor-vehicle record is outside the requested procedure. Only the three specified Title 21 exceptions may be considered under §4374(i).
entries.en: This motor-vehicle record is outside the requested procedure. Only the three specified Title 21 exceptions may be considered under §4374(i).
entries.es: Este registro de tránsito queda fuera del procedimiento solicitado. Solo las tres excepciones especificadas del título 21 pueden considerarse según §4374(i).

entries.originalEnglish: A conviction identified here is excluded from ordinary discretionary expungement by §4374(b). A pardon procedure has separate requirements.
entries.en: A conviction identified here is excluded from ordinary discretionary expungement by §4374(b). A pardon procedure has separate requirements.
entries.es: Una condena identificada está excluida de la eliminación discrecional ordinaria por §4374(b). El procedimiento de indulto tiene requisitos distintos.

entries.originalEnglish: The recorded offense or victim facts exclude mandatory expungement under §4373(b). Some listed misdemeanors may instead be considered by a court after seven years and all other requirements.
entries.en: The recorded offense or victim facts exclude mandatory expungement under §4373(b). Some listed misdemeanors may instead be considered by a court after seven years and all other requirements.
entries.es: Los hechos registrados sobre el delito o la víctima excluyen la eliminación obligatoria según §4373(b). Algunos delitos menores enumerados pueden ser considerados por un tribunal después de siete años y al cumplir los demás requisitos.

entries.originalEnglish: The five-year multiple-case provision does not include a misdemeanor listed in §4373(b). Review the separate cases and procedures.
entries.en: The five-year multiple-case provision does not include a misdemeanor listed in §4373(b). Review the separate cases and procedures.
entries.es: La disposición de cinco años para varios casos no incluye un delito menor enumerado en §4373(b). Revise los casos y procedimientos por separado.

entries.originalEnglish: A non-excepted pending criminal charge or an unfinished sentence prevents this Delaware request from proceeding now.
entries.en: A non-excepted pending criminal charge or an unfinished sentence prevents this Delaware request from proceeding now.
entries.es: Un cargo penal pendiente no exceptuado o una sentencia sin terminar impide que esta solicitud de Delaware avance ahora.

entries.originalEnglish: Restitution or other unresolved payment obligations prevent this request from proceeding now. An exception for fines or fees does not establish that restitution was paid.
entries.en: Restitution or other unresolved payment obligations prevent this request from proceeding now. An exception for fines or fees does not establish that restitution was paid.
entries.es: La restitución u otras obligaciones de pago sin resolver impiden que esta solicitud avance ahora. Una excepción para multas o tasas no establece que se pagó la restitución.

entries.originalEnglish: A court must decide whether to waive or convert these unpaid fines or fees under §4372(l). Nonwilful nonpayment is not an automatic waiver.
entries.en: A court must decide whether to waive or convert these unpaid fines or fees under §4372(l). Nonwilful nonpayment is not an automatic waiver.
entries.es: Un tribunal debe decidir si exime o convierte estas multas o tasas impagadas según §4372(l). El impago no intencional no constituye una exención automática.

entries.originalEnglish: Confirm eligibility of every charge in each affected case. A qualifying conviction alone does not establish whole-case eligibility.
entries.en: Confirm eligibility of every charge in each affected case. A qualifying conviction alone does not establish whole-case eligibility.
entries.es: Confirme que todos los cargos de cada caso afectado reúnen los requisitos. Una condena que reúne los requisitos no establece por sí sola que el caso completo los reúna.

entries.originalEnglish: Supply the requested real calendar date from the record. An unknown, impossible or future date cannot establish the Delaware waiting period.
entries.en: Supply the requested real calendar date from the record. An unknown, impossible or future date cannot establish the Delaware waiting period.
entries.es: Indique la fecha solicitada tal como consta en el registro; debe ser una fecha real del calendario. Una fecha desconocida, imposible o futura no puede establecer el período de espera de Delaware.

entries.originalEnglish: The old unresolved-charge exception requires seven years, no active warrant and no documented case activity in the last twelve months. These facts are not established.
entries.en: The old unresolved-charge exception requires seven years, no active warrant and no documented case activity in the last twelve months. These facts are not established.
entries.es: La excepción para cargos antiguos sin resolver requiere siete años, ninguna orden de arresto activa y ninguna actividad documentada en los últimos doce meses. Estos hechos no están establecidos.

entries.originalEnglish: This felony conviction occurred after expungement of a prior felony conviction and is excluded by §4372(f)(4)(a) from this ordinary court procedure.
entries.en: This felony conviction occurred after expungement of a prior felony conviction and is excluded by §4372(f)(4)(a) from this ordinary court procedure.
entries.es: Esta condena por delito grave ocurrió después de la eliminación de una condena anterior por delito grave y está excluida de este procedimiento judicial ordinario por §4372(f)(4)(a).

entries.originalEnglish: The applicable ten-year period after a prior conviction expungement has not ended under §4372(f)(4)(b). This restriction does not apply to a request under §4373(a)(1) or (a)(2).
entries.en: The applicable ten-year period after a prior conviction expungement has not ended under §4372(f)(4)(b). This restriction does not apply to a request under §4373(a)(1) or (a)(2).
entries.es: No ha terminado el período aplicable de diez años después de la eliminación de una condena anterior según §4372(f)(4)(b). Esta restricción no se aplica a una solicitud bajo §4373(a)(1) o (a)(2).

entries.originalEnglish: A single case containing only violations requires review under the mandatory procedure; it does not establish a §4374(a) court-petition category.
entries.en: A single case containing only violations requires review under the mandatory procedure; it does not establish a §4374(a) court-petition category.
entries.es: Un solo caso con únicamente infracciones requiere revisión bajo el procedimiento obligatorio; no establece una categoría de petición judicial de §4374(a).

entries.originalEnglish: Multiple mandatory-eligible cases may share an application, but each case must first be checked separately under §4373.
entries.en: Multiple mandatory-eligible cases may share an application, but each case must first be checked separately under §4373.
entries.es: Varios casos que reúnen los requisitos para la eliminación obligatoria pueden compartir una solicitud, pero cada caso debe verificarse primero por separado según §4373.

entries.originalEnglish: This felony is not one of the specific convictions listed for mandatory expungement. Ordinary discretionary and pardon procedures have separate requirements.
entries.en: This felony is not one of the specific convictions listed for mandatory expungement. Ordinary discretionary and pardon procedures have separate requirements.
entries.es: Este delito grave no es una de las condenas específicas enumeradas para eliminación obligatoria. Los procedimientos discrecional ordinario y de indulto tienen requisitos distintos.

entries.originalEnglish: The other conviction history does not satisfy this procedure. The statutory alcohol, personal-use marijuana, paraphernalia and Title 21 exceptions were considered separately.
entries.en: The other conviction history does not satisfy this procedure. The statutory alcohol, personal-use marijuana, paraphernalia and Title 21 exceptions were considered separately.
entries.es: Los otros antecedentes de condenas no cumplen este procedimiento. Se consideraron por separado las excepciones legales de alcohol, marihuana para uso personal, parafernalia y título 21.

entries.originalEnglish: The waiting period for this exact Delaware conviction category has not ended. Discretionary and mandatory procedures use different periods and anchors.
entries.en: The waiting period for this exact Delaware conviction category has not ended. Discretionary and mandatory procedures use different periods and anchors.
entries.es: No ha terminado el período de espera de esta categoría exacta de condena de Delaware. Los procedimientos discrecional y obligatorio usan períodos y fechas de inicio distintos.

entries.originalEnglish: The supplied facts meet the checked Delaware timing and exclusion predicates. This is not an expungement order, a finding of manifest injustice or permission to purchase a packet.
entries.en: The supplied facts meet the checked Delaware timing and exclusion predicates. This is not an expungement order, a finding of manifest injustice or permission to purchase a packet.
entries.es: Los hechos proporcionados cumplen los requisitos de plazos y exclusiones de Delaware verificados. Esto no es una orden de eliminación, una determinación de injusticia manifiesta ni permiso para comprar un paquete.

entries.originalEnglish: What would you like to check for this adult conviction record?
entries.en: What would you like to check for this adult conviction record?
entries.es: ¿Qué desea consultar sobre este registro de condena de adulto?

entries.originalEnglish: Which convictions are included in this request?
entries.en: Which convictions are included in this request?
entries.es: ¿Qué condenas se incluyen en esta solicitud?

entries.originalEnglish: What do the records show for every other charge in the case or cases requested?
entries.en: What do the records show for every other charge in the case or cases requested?
entries.es: ¿Qué indican los registros sobre todos los demás cargos de los casos solicitados?

entries.originalEnglish: Does the conviction record identify one of these exact statutory groups?
entries.en: Does the conviction record identify one of these exact statutory groups?
entries.es: ¿El registro de condena identifica uno de estos grupos legales exactos?

entries.originalEnglish: Does any conviction requested involve one of these offenses?
entries.en: Does any conviction requested involve one of these offenses?
entries.es: ¿Alguna condena solicitada corresponde a uno de estos delitos?

entries.originalEnglish: Which of these facts or misdemeanor groups appear in the case record?
entries.en: Which of these facts or misdemeanor groups appear in the case record?
entries.es: ¿Cuáles de estos hechos o grupos de delitos menores aparecen en el expediente?

entries.originalEnglish: Does the conviction record include any of these additional court-expungement exclusions?
entries.en: Does the conviction record include any of these additional court-expungement exclusions?
entries.es: ¿El registro incluye alguna de estas exclusiones adicionales de eliminación judicial?

entries.originalEnglish: Does this request include a Title 21 offense or a county/municipal equivalent?
entries.en: Does this request include a Title 21 offense or a county/municipal equivalent?
entries.es: ¿Esta solicitud incluye un delito del título 21 o un equivalente del condado o municipio?

entries.originalEnglish: Outside the requested cases, which prior or later convictions are on the record?
entries.en: Outside the requested cases, which prior or later convictions are on the record?
entries.es: Fuera de los casos solicitados, ¿qué condenas anteriores o posteriores aparecen en el registro?

entries.originalEnglish: Has eligibility of every charge in each other case been established independently under §4373?
entries.en: Has eligibility of every charge in each other case been established independently under §4373?
entries.es: ¿Se ha establecido por separado que todos los cargos de cada uno de los demás casos reúnen los requisitos según §4373?

entries.originalEnglish: Which criminal charges are currently pending?
entries.en: Which criminal charges are currently pending?
entries.es: ¿Qué cargos penales están pendientes actualmente?

entries.originalEnglish: Are you currently serving incarceration, parole or probation?
entries.en: Are you currently serving incarceration, parole or probation?
entries.es: ¿Actualmente cumple encarcelamiento, libertad bajo palabra o libertad condicional?

entries.originalEnglish: What is the status of the money owed for these convictions?
entries.en: What is the status of the money owed for these convictions?
entries.es: ¿Cuál es la situación del dinero adeudado por estas condenas?

entries.originalEnglish: Was there incarceration for any conviction included in this request?
entries.en: Was there incarceration for any conviction included in this request?
entries.es: ¿Hubo encarcelamiento por alguna condena incluida en esta solicitud?

entries.originalEnglish: Have you previously been granted expungement of a conviction?
entries.en: Have you previously been granted expungement of a conviction?
entries.es: ¿Se le concedió antes la eliminación de una condena?

entries.originalEnglish: Is there an active warrant in any case with an unresolved charge?
entries.en: Is there an active warrant in any case with an unresolved charge?
entries.es: ¿Hay una orden de arresto activa en algún caso con un cargo sin resolver?

entries.originalEnglish: Is there documented case activity in the last 12 months for any unresolved charge?
entries.en: Is there documented case activity in the last 12 months for any unresolved charge?
entries.es: ¿Hay actividad documentada en los últimos 12 meses en algún caso con un cargo sin resolver?

entries.originalEnglish: What is the conviction date, or the most recent conviction date for multiple cases?
entries.en: What is the conviction date, or the most recent conviction date for multiple cases?
entries.es: ¿Cuál es la fecha de condena, o la fecha más reciente si son varios casos?

entries.originalEnglish: What is the latest release-from-incarceration date for the convictions requested?
entries.en: What is the latest release-from-incarceration date for the convictions requested?
entries.es: ¿Cuál es la fecha más reciente de puesta en libertad por las condenas solicitadas?

entries.originalEnglish: On what date was the prior conviction expungement granted?
entries.en: On what date was the prior conviction expungement granted?
entries.es: ¿En qué fecha se concedió la eliminación de la condena anterior?

entries.originalEnglish: What is the date of the most recent unresolved charge?
entries.en: What is the date of the most recent unresolved charge?
entries.es: ¿Cuál es la fecha del cargo sin resolver más reciente?

entries.originalEnglish: Check your complete criminal history, the convictions in this request, and any earlier sealing applications and orders. An old eligible-conviction count does not establish these separate facts.
entries.en: Check your complete criminal history, the convictions in this request, and any earlier sealing applications and orders. An old eligible-conviction count does not establish these separate facts.
entries.es: Revise todos sus antecedentes penales, las condenas de esta solicitud y las solicitudes y órdenes de sellado anteriores. El recuento anterior de condenas elegibles no establece estos hechos por separado.

entries.originalEnglish: The history, requested convictions, felony counts or earlier sealing orders do not agree. Check the records before continuing.
entries.en: The history, requested convictions, felony counts or earlier sealing orders do not agree. Check the records before continuing.
entries.es: Los antecedentes, las condenas solicitadas, los recuentos de delitos graves o las órdenes de sellado anteriores no concuerdan. Revise los expedientes antes de continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: The complete criminal history exceeds this procedure's two-crime or one-felony limit. This includes convictions outside this sealing request.
entries.en: The complete criminal history exceeds this procedure's two-crime or one-felony limit. This includes convictions outside this sealing request.
entries.es: Los antecedentes penales completos superan el límite de dos delitos o un delito grave de este procedimiento. Esto incluye condenas fuera de esta solicitud de sellado.

entries.originalEnglish: This request exceeds the limit of two eligible offenses and no more than one felony.
entries.en: This request exceeds the limit of two eligible offenses and no more than one felony.
entries.es: Esta solicitud supera el límite de dos delitos elegibles y no más de un delito grave.

entries.originalEnglish: A shared case number or concurrent sentences do not establish a single criminal transaction. A legal reviewer must check the connected acts and which offenses can be grouped.
entries.en: A shared case number or concurrent sentences do not establish a single criminal transaction. A legal reviewer must check the connected acts and which offenses can be grouped.
entries.es: Un número de caso compartido o penas simultáneas no establecen una sola transacción delictiva. Un revisor legal debe examinar los actos relacionados y qué delitos pueden agruparse.

entries.originalEnglish: The convictions already sealed under CPL 160.59 and those requested exceed the remaining statutory capacity.
entries.en: The convictions already sealed under CPL 160.59 and those requested exceed the remaining statutory capacity.
entries.es: Las condenas ya selladas bajo CPL 160.59 y las solicitadas superan la capacidad restante permitida por la ley.

entries.originalEnglish: An order under CPL 160.58 is not automatically the maximum allowed. A legal reviewer must identify the treatment convictions and additional prior misdemeanors sealed before applying CPL 160.59(3)(b).
entries.en: An order under CPL 160.58 is not automatically the maximum allowed. A legal reviewer must identify the treatment convictions and additional prior misdemeanors sealed before applying CPL 160.59(3)(b).
entries.es: Una orden bajo CPL 160.58 no significa automáticamente que se alcanzó el máximo permitido. Un revisor legal debe identificar las condenas del programa de tratamiento y los delitos menores anteriores adicionales sellados antes de aplicar CPL 160.59(3)(b).

entries.originalEnglish: Check the sentencing, conviction and incarceration records. A broad elapsed-time answer cannot replace the dates and periods needed for this ten-year calculation.
entries.en: Check the sentencing, conviction and incarceration records. A broad elapsed-time answer cannot replace the dates and periods needed for this ten-year calculation.
entries.es: Revise los registros de sentencia, condena y encarcelamiento. Una respuesta general sobre el tiempo transcurrido no reemplaza las fechas y los períodos necesarios para este cálculo de diez años.

entries.originalEnglish: The conviction, sentence, release and incarceration-period answers conflict. Check the records; no release date or missing period can be assumed.
entries.en: The conviction, sentence, release and incarceration-period answers conflict. Check the records; no release date or missing period can be assumed.
entries.es: Las respuestas sobre la condena, la sentencia, la liberación y los períodos de encarcelamiento no concuerdan. Revise los registros; no se puede suponer una fecha de liberación ni un período faltante.

entries.originalEnglish: Check every incarceration period. Use real admission and release dates, in that order, with no future dates. Keep each period on its own line as YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD.
entries.en: Check every incarceration period. Use real admission and release dates, in that order, with no future dates. Keep each period on its own line as YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD.
entries.es: Revise cada período de encarcelamiento. Use fechas reales de ingreso y liberación, en ese orden, sin fechas futuras. Escriba cada período en una línea separada como AAAA-MM-DD/AAAA-MM-DD.

entries.originalEnglish: The incarceration record shows that release has not occurred. Do not estimate a future release date for this calculation.
entries.en: The incarceration record shows that release has not occurred. Do not estimate a future release date for this calculation.
entries.es: El registro de encarcelamiento indica que la liberación aún no ocurrió. No estime una fecha de liberación futura para este cálculo.

entries.originalEnglish: Ten years have not yet elapsed under this procedure after accounting for the applicable anchor and incarceration time.
entries.en: Ten years have not yet elapsed under this procedure after accounting for the applicable anchor and incarceration time.
entries.es: Aún no han transcurrido diez años bajo este procedimiento después de considerar la fecha inicial aplicable y el tiempo de encarcelamiento.

entries.originalEnglish: The result depends on how incarceration already covered by the sentencing or release anchor is treated under CPL 160.59(5). A qualified legal reviewer must resolve that calculation before this request can proceed.
entries.en: The result depends on how incarceration already covered by the sentencing or release anchor is treated under CPL 160.59(5). A qualified legal reviewer must resolve that calculation before this request can proceed.
entries.es: El resultado depende de cómo se trate el encarcelamiento ya comprendido en la fecha inicial de sentencia o liberación bajo CPL 160.59(5). Un revisor legal calificado debe resolver ese cálculo antes de que esta solicitud pueda continuar.

entries.originalEnglish: Which procedure do you want checked for this conviction?
entries.en: Which procedure do you want checked for this conviction?
entries.es: ¿Qué procedimiento quiere que se revise para esta condena?

entries.originalEnglish: How many criminal convictions remain on your complete record?
entries.en: How many criminal convictions remain on your complete record?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas penales permanecen en todos sus antecedentes?

entries.originalEnglish: How many convictions on your complete record are felonies?
entries.en: How many convictions on your complete record are felonies?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas de todos sus antecedentes son por delitos graves?

entries.originalEnglish: How many individual convictions do you want included in this sealing request?
entries.en: How many individual convictions do you want included in this sealing request?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas individuales quiere incluir en esta solicitud de sellado?

entries.originalEnglish: How many of the convictions in this request are felonies?
entries.en: How many of the convictions in this request are felonies?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas de esta solicitud son por delitos graves?

entries.originalEnglish: How are the acts underlying these convictions related?
entries.en: How are the acts underlying these convictions related?
entries.es: ¿Cómo se relacionan los actos que dieron lugar a estas condenas?

entries.originalEnglish: What happened to any earlier CPL 160.59 applications?
entries.en: What happened to any earlier CPL 160.59 applications?
entries.es: ¿Qué ocurrió con las solicitudes anteriores bajo CPL 160.59?

entries.originalEnglish: How many convictions have already been sealed by a CPL 160.59 order?
entries.en: How many convictions have already been sealed by a CPL 160.59 order?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas ya se sellaron mediante una orden bajo CPL 160.59?

entries.originalEnglish: How many convictions already sealed under CPL 160.59 are felonies?
entries.en: How many convictions already sealed under CPL 160.59 are felonies?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas ya selladas bajo CPL 160.59 son por delitos graves?

entries.originalEnglish: Do the records show a granted sealing order under CPL 160.58?
entries.en: Do the records show a granted sealing order under CPL 160.58?
entries.es: ¿Los registros muestran una orden de sellado concedida bajo CPL 160.58?

entries.originalEnglish: Did the latest criminal sentence include incarceration, including incarceration with probation?
entries.en: Did the latest criminal sentence include incarceration, including incarceration with probation?
entries.es: ¿La sentencia penal más reciente incluyó encarcelamiento, incluso junto con libertad condicional?

entries.originalEnglish: Since the earliest conviction in this request, what incarceration has occurred?
entries.en: Since the earliest conviction in this request, what incarceration has occurred?
entries.es: ¿Qué encarcelamiento ha ocurrido desde la primera condena de esta solicitud?

entries.originalEnglish: What is the date of the earliest conviction included in this request?
entries.en: What is the date of the earliest conviction included in this request?
entries.es: ¿Cuál es la fecha de la primera condena incluida en esta solicitud?

entries.originalEnglish: What were all admission and release dates for incarceration since that conviction?
entries.en: What were all admission and release dates for incarceration since that conviction?
entries.es: ¿Cuáles fueron todas las fechas de ingreso y liberación de encarcelamientos desde esa condena?

entries.originalEnglish: Does a conviction requested for sealing fall in the CPL 160.59 excluded-offense categories?
entries.en: Does a conviction requested for sealing fall in the CPL 160.59 excluded-offense categories?
entries.es: ¿Alguna condena que solicita sellar pertenece a las categorías de delitos excluidos de CPL 160.59?

entries.originalEnglish: When was the sentence imposed on your latest criminal conviction?
entries.en: When was the sentence imposed on your latest criminal conviction?
entries.es: ¿Cuándo se impuso la sentencia de su condena penal más reciente?

entries.originalEnglish: What was your latest release date from incarceration?
entries.en: What was your latest release date from incarceration?
entries.es: ¿Cuál fue su fecha más reciente de liberación del encarcelamiento?

entries.originalEnglish: How many treatment-related convictions did the entered CPL 160.58 order seal?
entries.en: How many treatment-related convictions did the entered CPL 160.58 order seal?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas relacionadas con el tratamiento selló la orden concedida bajo CPL 160.58?

entries.originalEnglish: How many additional earlier eligible misdemeanors did that order seal, apart from the treatment convictions?
entries.en: How many additional earlier eligible misdemeanors did that order seal, apart from the treatment convictions?
entries.es: ¿Cuántos delitos menores elegibles anteriores adicionales selló esa orden, aparte de las condenas del tratamiento?

entries.originalEnglish: Were the acts closely connected in both time and circumstances as one criminal incident?
entries.en: Were the acts closely connected in both time and circumstances as one criminal incident?
entries.es: ¿Estuvieron los actos estrechamente relacionados en tiempo y circunstancias como un solo incidente delictivo?

entries.originalEnglish: Were the acts integral parts of one criminal venture with a closely connected purpose or objective?
entries.en: Were the acts integral parts of one criminal venture with a closely connected purpose or objective?
entries.es: ¿Fueron los actos partes integrales de una sola actividad delictiva con un propósito u objetivo estrechamente relacionado?

entries.originalEnglish: Is the only connection a shared case number, date, court or sentence, rather than the acts themselves?
entries.en: Is the only connection a shared case number, date, court or sentence, rather than the acts themselves?
entries.es: ¿Es la única conexión un número de caso, fecha, tribunal o sentencia compartidos, en lugar de los actos mismos?

entries.originalEnglish: Did the acts cause death, injury, loss or other consequences to more than one victim?
entries.en: Did the acts cause death, injury, loss or other consequences to more than one victim?
entries.es: ¿Causaron los actos muerte, lesiones, pérdidas u otras consecuencias a más de una víctima?

entries.originalEnglish: Check the entered CPL 160.58 order: count treatment-related convictions separately from additional earlier misdemeanors. A pending or denied application is not an entered order.
entries.en: Check the entered CPL 160.58 order: count treatment-related convictions separately from additional earlier misdemeanors. A pending or denied application is not an entered order.
entries.es: Revise la orden concedida bajo CPL 160.58: cuente por separado las condenas relacionadas con el tratamiento y los delitos menores anteriores adicionales. Una solicitud pendiente o denegada no es una orden concedida.

entries.originalEnglish: The order components do not agree with the CPL 160.58 treatment-conviction and additional-misdemeanor structure. Check the actual order with a legal reviewer.
entries.en: The order components do not agree with the CPL 160.58 treatment-conviction and additional-misdemeanor structure. Check the actual order with a legal reviewer.
entries.es: Los componentes de la orden no concuerdan con la estructura de condenas de tratamiento y delitos menores adicionales de CPL 160.58. Revise la orden dictada con un revisor legal.

entries.originalEnglish: Check how the acts were connected in time, circumstances and criminal purpose, whether the only connection is a shared docket or sentence, and whether multiple victims were involved.
entries.en: Check how the acts were connected in time, circumstances and criminal purpose, whether the only connection is a shared docket or sentence, and whether multiple victims were involved.
entries.es: Revise cómo se relacionaron los actos en tiempo, circunstancias y propósito delictivo, si la única conexión es un expediente o sentencia compartidos y si hubo varias víctimas.

entries.originalEnglish: The answers describe both a factual connection and only a shared docket or sentence. Check the underlying acts before asking for transaction review.
entries.en: The answers describe both a factual connection and only a shared docket or sentence. Check the underlying acts before asking for transaction review.
entries.es: Las respuestas describen tanto una conexión entre los hechos como únicamente un expediente o sentencia compartidos. Revise los actos antes de solicitar la revisión de la transacción.

entries.originalEnglish: Check the conviction record and the conduct details shown here. An answer that the offense qualifies does not supply those facts.
entries.en: Check the conviction record and the conduct details shown here. An answer that the offense qualifies does not supply those facts.
entries.es: Revise el registro de condena y los detalles de la conducta que se indican aquí. Decir que el delito califica no aporta esos hechos.

entries.originalEnglish: These details about the same conviction do not agree. Review the original record and correct the affected answers.
entries.en: These details about the same conviction do not agree. Review the original record and correct the affected answers.
entries.es: Estos detalles sobre la misma condena no coinciden. Revise el registro original y corrija las respuestas afectadas.

entries.originalEnglish: This statute needs a record-specific Proposition 64 review; it cannot be treated as a different marijuana conviction.
entries.en: This statute needs a record-specific Proposition 64 review; it cannot be treated as a different marijuana conviction.
entries.es: Esta ley necesita una revisión específica del registro bajo la Proposición 64; no puede tratarse como otra condena por cannabis.

entries.originalEnglish: Checking existing relief or considering another procedure does not request a new Proposition 64 court filing.
entries.en: Checking existing relief or considering another procedure does not request a new Proposition 64 court filing.
entries.es: Verificar una reparación existente o considerar otro procedimiento no solicita una nueva presentación judicial bajo la Proposición 64.

entries.originalEnglish: The offense date or current statute needs review before applying the prior-conviction procedure. This does not determine that no relief is available.
entries.en: The offense date or current statute needs review before applying the prior-conviction procedure. This does not determine that no relief is available.
entries.es: La fecha del delito o la ley actual necesita revisión antes de aplicar el procedimiento para condenas anteriores. Esto no determina que no haya reparación disponible.

entries.originalEnglish: Proposition 64 also applies to juvenile adjudications. This record needs the juvenile procedure and forms, not the adult CR-400 packet.
entries.en: Proposition 64 also applies to juvenile adjudications. This record needs the juvenile procedure and forms, not the adult CR-400 packet.
entries.es: La Proposición 64 también se aplica a resoluciones de menores. Este registro necesita el procedimiento y los formularios para menores, no el paquete CR-400 para adultos.

entries.originalEnglish: Review the existing order and the additional result requested. Automatic relief may make a filing unnecessary, but it does not always provide every available benefit.
entries.en: Review the existing order and the additional result requested. Automatic relief may make a filing unnecessary, but it does not always provide every available benefit.
entries.es: Revise la orden existente y el resultado adicional solicitado. La reparación automática puede hacer innecesaria una presentación, pero no siempre otorga todos los beneficios disponibles.

entries.originalEnglish: The substance in the conviction needs review. A marijuana rule cannot be applied to a different or unidentified drug.
entries.en: The substance in the conviction needs review. A marijuana rule cannot be applied to a different or unidentified drug.
entries.es: La sustancia de la condena necesita revisión. Una regla de cannabis no puede aplicarse a una droga distinta o no identificada.

entries.originalEnglish: The place and circumstances of possession need review under the rules for that conduct.
entries.en: The place and circumstances of possession need review under the rules for that conduct.
entries.es: El lugar y las circunstancias de la posesión necesitan revisión bajo las reglas de esa conducta.

entries.originalEnglish: Possession, public smoking, vehicle use and school-related conduct have different rules. Review the exact conduct before selecting the requested relief.
entries.en: Possession, public smoking, vehicle use and school-related conduct have different rules. Review the exact conduct before selecting the requested relief.
entries.es: La posesión, fumar en público, el uso en vehículos y la conducta relacionada con escuelas tienen reglas distintas. Revise la conducta exacta antes de elegir la reparación solicitada.

entries.originalEnglish: This concentrate quantity falls within a statutory amendment boundary that needs review for this record.
entries.en: This concentrate quantity falls within a statutory amendment boundary that needs review for this record.
entries.es: Esta cantidad de concentrado cae dentro del límite de una modificación legal que necesita revisión para este registro.

entries.originalEnglish: Review whether this was a sale, unpaid gift, personal transport, or other conduct. These have different legal consequences.
entries.en: Review whether this was a sale, unpaid gift, personal transport, or other conduct. These have different legal consequences.
entries.es: Revise si fue una venta, un regalo sin compensación, transporte personal u otra conducta. Tienen consecuencias legales distintas.

entries.originalEnglish: This cross-border conduct and quantity may permit a felony charge. The court must assess the specific exception; it is not an automatic denial.
entries.en: This cross-border conduct and quantity may permit a felony charge. The court must assess the specific exception; it is not an automatic denial.
entries.es: Esta conducta transfronteriza y cantidad pueden permitir un cargo de delito grave. El tribunal debe evaluar la excepción específica; no es una denegación automática.

entries.originalEnglish: Review the exact import or export conduct before treating it as lawful possession or a lesser offense.
entries.en: Review the exact import or export conduct before treating it as lawful possession or a lesser offense.
entries.es: Revise la conducta exacta de importación o exportación antes de tratarla como posesión legal o un delito de menor gravedad.

entries.originalEnglish: These facts may permit felony treatment under this particular offense section. Record-specific review is needed; the same facts are not a blanket bar to all Proposition 64 relief.
entries.en: These facts may permit felony treatment under this particular offense section. Record-specific review is needed; the same facts are not a blanket bar to all Proposition 64 relief.
entries.es: Estos hechos pueden permitir el tratamiento como delito grave bajo esta sección particular. Se necesita revisión del registro; no son una prohibición general de toda reparación bajo la Proposición 64.

entries.originalEnglish: Confirm the final conviction or juvenile adjudication for this request. An arrest, charge or program alone is not a conviction.
entries.en: Confirm the final conviction or juvenile adjudication for this request. An arrest, charge or program alone is not a conviction.
entries.es: Confirme la condena final o resolución de menores para esta solicitud. Un arresto, cargo o programa por sí solo no es una condena.

entries.originalEnglish: The current facts do not yet establish a reduction from the recorded offense level. Review the record and any other applicable relief.
entries.en: The current facts do not yet establish a reduction from the recorded offense level. Review the record and any other applicable relief.
entries.es: Los hechos actuales aún no establecen una reducción del nivel de delito registrado. Revise el registro y cualquier otra reparación aplicable.

entries.originalEnglish: The requested remedy and the conduct facts do not agree. Dismissal and sealing concerns conduct that became lawful; redesignation concerns conduct that became a lesser offense.
entries.en: The requested remedy and the conduct facts do not agree. Dismissal and sealing concerns conduct that became lawful; redesignation concerns conduct that became a lesser offense.
entries.es: La reparación solicitada y los hechos de la conducta no coinciden. La desestimación y el sellado corresponden a conducta que se volvió legal; la reclasificación, a conducta que se volvió un delito de menor gravedad.

entries.originalEnglish: For a sentence still being served, including probation, parole, PRCS or mandatory supervision, the court presumes eligibility unless the opposing party proves otherwise by clear and convincing evidence. The court may deny relief for an unreasonable risk of danger to public safety. These are court decisions, not facts you must certify.
entries.en: For a sentence still being served, including probation, parole, PRCS or mandatory supervision, the court presumes eligibility unless the opposing party proves otherwise by clear and convincing evidence. The court may deny relief for an unreasonable risk of danger to public safety. These are court decisions, not facts you must certify.
entries.es: Para una sentencia que aún se cumple, incluidas la libertad a prueba (probation), la libertad condicional (parole), supervisión comunitaria posterior a la liberación (PRCS) o supervisión obligatoria, el tribunal presume la elegibilidad salvo prueba clara y convincente en contrario de la parte opositora. El tribunal puede denegar la reparación por un riesgo irrazonable de peligro para la seguridad pública. Son decisiones judiciales, no hechos que usted deba certificar.

entries.originalEnglish: For a completed sentence, the court presumes eligibility unless the opposing party proves otherwise by clear and convincing evidence. The currently-serving branch's public-safety exception does not apply to this application. The court decides dismissal and sealing or redesignation; a hearing is not required unless requested by the applicant.
entries.en: For a completed sentence, the court presumes eligibility unless the opposing party proves otherwise by clear and convincing evidence. The currently-serving branch's public-safety exception does not apply to this application. The court decides dismissal and sealing or redesignation; a hearing is not required unless requested by the applicant.
entries.es: Para una sentencia cumplida, el tribunal presume la elegibilidad salvo prueba clara y convincente en contrario de la parte opositora. La excepción de seguridad pública de la vía para sentencias aún en cumplimiento no se aplica a esta solicitud. El tribunal decide la desestimación y el sellado o la reclasificación; no se requiere audiencia salvo que la persona solicitante la pida.

entries.originalEnglish: Which Health and Safety Code section is on the marijuana conviction record?
entries.en: Which Health and Safety Code section is on the marijuana conviction record?
entries.es: ¿Qué sección del Código de Salud y Seguridad figura en el registro de la condena por cannabis?

entries.originalEnglish: What help do you want with this marijuana record?
entries.en: What help do you want with this marijuana record?
entries.es: ¿Qué ayuda desea con este registro de cannabis?

entries.originalEnglish: When did the conduct in this conviction happen?
entries.en: When did the conduct in this conviction happen?
entries.es: ¿Cuándo ocurrió la conducta de esta condena?

entries.originalEnglish: How old were you when that conduct happened?
entries.en: How old were you when that conduct happened?
entries.es: ¿Cuántos años tenía cuando ocurrió esa conducta?

entries.originalEnglish: Was this an adult criminal conviction or a juvenile court adjudication?
entries.en: Was this an adult criminal conviction or a juvenile court adjudication?
entries.es: ¿Fue una condena penal de adulto o una resolución del tribunal de menores?

entries.originalEnglish: What Proposition 64 relief has the court already ordered for this conviction?
entries.en: What Proposition 64 relief has the court already ordered for this conviction?
entries.es: ¿Qué reparación bajo la Proposición 64 ya ordenó el tribunal para esta condena?

entries.originalEnglish: What additional result are you asking for?
entries.en: What additional result are you asking for?
entries.es: ¿Qué resultado adicional solicita?

entries.originalEnglish: What substance did the conviction involve?
entries.en: What substance did the conviction involve?
entries.es: ¿Qué sustancia involucró la condena?

entries.originalEnglish: How many grams of cannabis, excluding concentrate, were involved?
entries.en: How many grams of cannabis, excluding concentrate, were involved?
entries.es: ¿Cuántos gramos de cannabis, sin incluir concentrado, estaban involucrados?

entries.originalEnglish: How many grams of concentrated cannabis were involved?
entries.en: How many grams of concentrated cannabis were involved?
entries.es: ¿Cuántos gramos de cannabis concentrado estaban involucrados?

entries.originalEnglish: Where and how was the cannabis possessed or used?
entries.en: Where and how was the cannabis possessed or used?
entries.es: ¿Dónde y cómo se poseía o usaba el cannabis?

entries.originalEnglish: How many living cannabis plants did your conduct involve?
entries.en: How many living cannabis plants did your conduct involve?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas plantas vivas de cannabis involucró su conducta?

entries.originalEnglish: How many living cannabis plants were at the residence in total, including other people's plants?
entries.en: How many living cannabis plants were at the residence in total, including other people's plants?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas plantas vivas de cannabis había en total en la residencia, incluidas las de otras personas?

entries.originalEnglish: Were the plants kept inside a private residence or on its grounds?
entries.en: Were the plants kept inside a private residence or on its grounds?
entries.es: ¿Se guardaban las plantas dentro de una residencia privada o en su terreno?

entries.originalEnglish: Were the plants kept in a locked space?
entries.en: Were the plants kept in a locked space?
entries.es: ¿Se guardaban las plantas en un espacio cerrado con llave?

entries.originalEnglish: Could the plants be seen with unaided vision from a public place?
entries.en: Could the plants be seen with unaided vision from a public place?
entries.es: ¿Se podían ver las plantas a simple vista desde un lugar público?

entries.originalEnglish: Does the case record identify a violated local cultivation ordinance?
entries.en: Does the case record identify a violated local cultivation ordinance?
entries.es: ¿Identifica el expediente una ordenanza local de cultivo que se infringió?

entries.originalEnglish: Before this offense, were you convicted of any offense listed below?
entries.en: Before this offense, were you convicted of any offense listed below?
entries.es: ¿Antes de este delito, fue condenado por alguno de los delitos indicados abajo?

entries.originalEnglish: Did an earlier conviction require sex-offender registration under Penal Code section 290(c)?
entries.en: Did an earlier conviction require sex-offender registration under Penal Code section 290(c)?
entries.es: ¿Una condena anterior exigió registro como delincuente sexual bajo la sección 290(c) del Código Penal?

entries.originalEnglish: How many earlier convictions are recorded under the adult misdemeanor subsection for this same offense?
entries.en: How many earlier convictions are recorded under the adult misdemeanor subsection for this same offense?
entries.es: ¿Cuántas condenas anteriores constan bajo la subsección de delito menor para adultos de este mismo delito?

entries.originalEnglish: Does the cultivation record include any of these environmental violations or findings?
entries.en: Does the cultivation record include any of these environmental violations or findings?
entries.es: ¿Incluye el registro de cultivo alguna de estas infracciones o determinaciones ambientales?

entries.originalEnglish: Did the offense involve knowingly selling or attempting to sell cannabis to someone under 18?
entries.en: Did the offense involve knowingly selling or attempting to sell cannabis to someone under 18?
entries.es: ¿Involucró el delito vender o intentar vender cannabis a sabiendas a alguien menor de 18 años?

entries.originalEnglish: Did you knowingly hire, employ, or use someone age 20 or younger in the cannabis activity?
entries.en: Did you knowingly hire, employ, or use someone age 20 or younger in the cannabis activity?
entries.es: ¿Contrató, empleó o utilizó a sabiendas a alguien de 20 años o menos en la actividad de cannabis?

entries.originalEnglish: What did the sale or transportation conviction involve?
entries.en: What did the sale or transportation conviction involve?
entries.es: ¿Qué involucró la condena por venta o transporte?

entries.originalEnglish: Did this conduct cross California's state border?
entries.en: Did this conduct cross California's state border?
entries.es: ¿Cruzó esta conducta la frontera del estado de California?

entries.originalEnglish: How old was the person receiving the unpaid gift?
entries.en: How old was the person receiving the unpaid gift?
entries.es: ¿Cuántos años tenía la persona que recibió el regalo sin compensación?

entries.originalEnglish: Check the requested detail about the law, court, final case outcome and the help you want. A city police arrest, charge level, program admission or optional legal-name hint does not establish the procedure. Record facts are checked separately from your request.
entries.en: Check the requested detail about the law, court, final case outcome and the help you want. A city police arrest, charge level, program admission or optional legal-name hint does not establish the procedure. Record facts are checked separately from your request.
entries.es: Revise el dato solicitado sobre la ley, el tribunal, el resultado final del caso y la ayuda que desea. Un arresto por la policía municipal, el nivel del cargo, la admisión a un programa o una referencia opcional al nombre de un procedimiento no establece el procedimiento aplicable. Los hechos del expediente se revisan por separado de su solicitud.

entries.originalEnglish: The arrangement entered is not a diversion agreement. A generic program or deferred-disposition answer cannot establish the district-court diversion procedure. Review the actual agreement or order and its final disposition.
entries.en: The arrangement entered is not a diversion agreement. A generic program or deferred-disposition answer cannot establish the district-court diversion procedure. Review the actual agreement or order and its final disposition.
entries.es: El acuerdo o programa indicado no es un acuerdo de desvío. Una respuesta general sobre un programa o una resolución aplazada no establece el procedimiento de desvío del tribunal de distrito. Revise el acuerdo o la orden y su resolución final.

entries.originalEnglish: You asked about ending registration without also requesting expungement. Those are separate requests. The combined record-clearing route cannot stand in for your request; the registration-only procedure and delivery scope need review.
entries.en: You asked about ending registration without also requesting expungement. Those are separate requests. The combined record-clearing route cannot stand in for your request; the registration-only procedure and delivery scope need review.
entries.es: Preguntó sobre poner fin a la inscripción sin solicitar también la eliminación de antecedentes. Son solicitudes distintas. El procedimiento combinado no puede sustituir su solicitud; deben revisarse el procedimiento de inscripción por separado y los documentos correspondientes.

entries.originalEnglish: The registration record entered does not establish drug-only registration. The drug-offender registration procedure cannot be assumed for another category, mixed obligations or no current duty. Review the actual registration orders and the relief requested.
entries.en: The registration record entered does not establish drug-only registration. The drug-offender registration procedure cannot be assumed for another category, mixed obligations or no current duty. Review the actual registration orders and the relief requested.
entries.es: El registro indicado no establece una inscripción únicamente por drogas. No se puede suponer que el procedimiento de inscripción por drogas corresponda a otra categoría, obligaciones mixtas o la ausencia de una obligación actual. Revise las órdenes de inscripción y la ayuda solicitada.

entries.originalEnglish: The answers do not establish completed requirements of a specialty court established under K.S.A. 20-173. Ordinary treatment or diversion cannot substitute. Review the actual program record and other record-clearing options.
entries.en: The answers do not establish completed requirements of a specialty court established under K.S.A. 20-173. Ordinary treatment or diversion cannot substitute. Review the actual program record and other record-clearing options.
entries.es: Las respuestas no establecen que se hayan cumplido los requisitos de un tribunal especializado establecido conforme a K.S.A. 20-173. Un tratamiento o desvío ordinario no puede sustituirlo. Revise el expediente del programa y otras opciones para eliminar antecedentes.

entries.originalEnglish: The final statute entered is not K.S.A. 21-6419 or former K.S.A. 21-3512. The prostitution-specific coercion procedure cannot be established by the optional menu or a general description. Review the final record and other available procedures.
entries.en: The final statute entered is not K.S.A. 21-6419 or former K.S.A. 21-3512. The prostitution-specific coercion procedure cannot be established by the optional menu or a general description. Review the final record and other available procedures.
entries.es: La ley final indicada no es K.S.A. 21-6419 ni la antigua K.S.A. 21-3512. El menú opcional o una descripción general no establece el procedimiento de coacción específico para prostitución. Revise el expediente final y otros procedimientos disponibles.

entries.originalEnglish: This request needs a private review of the circumstances and the applicable procedure. No account of coercion or supporting evidence will be invented, and this result does not deny every record-clearing option.
entries.en: This request needs a private review of the circumstances and the applicable procedure. No account of coercion or supporting evidence will be invented, and this result does not deny every record-clearing option.
entries.es: Esta solicitud necesita una revisión privada de las circunstancias y del procedimiento aplicable. No se inventará un relato de coacción ni pruebas de apoyo, y este resultado no rechaza todas las opciones para eliminar antecedentes.

entries.originalEnglish: The district-court diversion agreement remains unfulfilled. Admission, another program's completion or a municipal agreement does not start this completed-diversion clock. Review the agreement and any applicable alternative procedure.
entries.en: The district-court diversion agreement remains unfulfilled. Admission, another program's completion or a municipal agreement does not start this completed-diversion clock. Review the agreement and any applicable alternative procedure.
entries.es: El acuerdo de desvío del tribunal de distrito sigue sin cumplirse. La admisión, el cumplimiento de otro programa o un acuerdo municipal no inicia el plazo para este desvío cumplido. Revise el acuerdo y cualquier procedimiento alternativo aplicable.

entries.originalEnglish: This municipal case was appealed to district court. The district-court procedure and form must match that appeal; the original municipal packet or an unrelated district procedure cannot substitute. The source provides for the district clerk to send an expungement order to municipal court, but the applicable filing details still need review.
entries.en: This municipal case was appealed to district court. The district-court procedure and form must match that appeal; the original municipal packet or an unrelated district procedure cannot substitute. The source provides for the district clerk to send an expungement order to municipal court, but the applicable filing details still need review.
entries.es: Este caso municipal fue apelado al tribunal de distrito. El procedimiento y el formulario del tribunal de distrito deben corresponder a esa apelación; el paquete municipal original o un procedimiento de distrito distinto no puede sustituirlos. La fuente dispone que el secretario del tribunal de distrito envíe la orden de eliminación al tribunal municipal, pero aún deben revisarse los detalles de presentación aplicables.
